Hi Samantha —

Great call this morning — appreciate you walking us through the use case and the internal stakeholders. As promised, a quick recap and suggested next steps so we can get the pilot contract routing moving:

- Pilot: 3-month evaluation of Redwood inference for realtime chat and embeddings for the AcroSearch product.
- Technical owners: Samantha (ML), Alan (Prod Infra)
- Security/Legal: Meera (legal) listed as primary reviewer; Procurement inbox handles PO/contract intake.
- Decision criteria: latency under 150ms p95, token cost targets, SOC2 controls and data residency assurances.

Proposed next steps:
1) Please confirm the legal contact who will own NDA/MSA redlines (Meera? correct?)
2) Procurement process: can procurement/a vendor intake person be looped in so we can share SOW and initial commercials?
3) I'll attach a draft MSA + pilot SOW for your internal teams to review. If you prefer, we can do redlines in DocuSign for speed.

Tentative timeline suggestion:
- This week: legal/procurement contact confirmed + intake of draft MSA/SOW
- Next week: legal redlines returned (aim for 3-5 business days)
- Two weeks: finalize and execute agreement, kickoff technical onboarding

Attachments: Redwood_Acrosoft_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf, Acrosoft_MSA_DRAFT_v1.pdf

If you confirm contacts I’ll loop them into a single thread to keep routing tidy.

Thanks —
